column1: # The 139 ledger residuals, split by how deeply the corpus reads each one.
# It was published into the kit 2026-09-14 from Tools/work/OPUS/build_residual_split.py.
# THIS FILE IS A GN160-ERA ARTIFACT AND ITS NAME CARRIES THE GENERATION. The tool reads
# Tools/work/verify/residual_addrs.txt - GN160's 139 residuals. The certified parent GN161
# has 30. Running the tool today would rewrite this file against a different generation
# without saying so, and five canonical documents cite it under this name.
# GFZ.V121.CodeDomain classification. unresolved = 0 is a hard gate for L1.
# THE BAND IS A PROXY AND DECIDES NOTHING. An interior citation is evidence that
# somebody read the body; it is not proof the body is explained, and progress.py says
# the same of its own interior-citation measure. BODY-READ means 'worth reading the
# page before assuming this needs new research', not 'already done'.
# _index/ and 99-Unresolved-Residual/ are excluded from the citation scan: they are
# where residuals are listed BECAUSE they are residual, so counting them would score
